newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP Yamasaki says favours lowering corporate taxes.
newsitem.headline: LDP Yamasaki says favours lowering corporate taxes.

text.p: The Liberal Democratic Party's top policy maker Taku Yamasaki on Tuesday told executives of Japan's biggest business lobby Keidanren that he would favour a reduction in corporate tax rates.

A spokeswoman for Keidanren quoted Yamasaki, who chairs the ruling party's Policy Research Council, as saying that taxation on corporations could be cut by one trillion yen by lowering the corporate tax rate to 35 percent from the current 37.5 percent.
Lowering corporate tax rates would be in line with the increasing trend by Japanese companies to internationalise operations, the spokeswoman quoted Yamasaki as saying.
